propositions: The parent-first cascade walk logic is duplicated across claim.py and transition.py with identical cycle guards and TOCTOU re-checks but different write primitives.
The _CASCADING_EDGES decision table resides only in transition.py and drives three cascading edges: open→in_progress, closed→open, and closed→in_progress, while claim.py hardcodes only the open edge.

A shared cascade_parent_first helper must extract the walk (ancestor recursion, cycle guard, benign-race re-check, error rewrap) while keeping decision tables and write primitives at their call sites.
The inbound cascade from Gerrit 2044 already single-sources decisions via _CASCADING_EDGES import but must retain its own write primitive and topmost-first event ordering guarantee.
All three cascading edges and the suppression of * → closed cascades must pass existing test suites unchanged after extraction.
